foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an annual report each year, starting the year after registration, and maintain a registered agent located at a registered office in Wisconsin.

evidence.quote: Please check box to request Optional Expedited Service  + $100.00
FORM 521 Mandatory FOREIGN REGISTRATION STATEMENT LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY Sec. 183.0903, Wis. Stats.
State of Wisconsin DEPARTMENT OF FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS Division of Corporate & Consumer Services
This entity type has an annual report requirement to file each year, starting the year after your entity was formed.
The entity must have a registered agent located at a registered office in Wisconsin.

notes: Collected on the VPN-up route. The DFI fee schedule lists foreign LLC Registration at $100.00+; Form 521 (revised May 2026) states the $100.00 filing fee and prices optional expedited processing at an additional $100.00 (the checkbox glyph in the expedited quote is a pypdf extraction artefact, kept verbatim). The form is mandatory and cites Wis. Stat. s. 183.0903.
